title: Incinerate of Venting Elementalist

stages.title: 1. RF Leveling
stages.goal: Start with the Fireball and Flame Wall groups. Enable Righteous Fire after your regeneration can support it.

stages.title: 2. IoV EO Day 1 (Yellow Maps)
stages.goal: Swap to Incinerate of Venting and use Elemental Overload in early maps.

stages.title: 3. IoV Crit Swap (Lv. 90)
stages.goal: Only move into the critical strike setup when the gear and gem links are ready.

stages.title: 4. IoV Crit Endgame
stages.goal: Tune the critical setup. Test standing still against bosses before increasing difficulty.

overview:
Use the campaign fire-spell setup. Farm or trade for Incinerate of Venting before the swap.

Source guide by smokie_777: https://pobarchives.com/build/wV7H3ggq
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/WBamNpUW03yL

PoB uses 3.29 simulation data. See the creator guide for assumptions and any additional stages.
